name: Cohere
h1: Cohere ARR: ~$500M in Enterprise and Sovereign AI.
intro: Cohere went from ~$13M of revenue in 2023 to a ~$500M annualized run rate in 2026 by refusing to build a chatbot — its business is private, secure LLM deployments for enterprises and governments. Every reported ARR, funding and valuation number is collected below, each traced back to a public source.

modelTitle: How Sovereign Deployments Replace Consumer Subscriptions.
modelParagraphs: Cohere sells to enterprises and governments, not consumers. API pricing is deliberately cheap relative to frontier labs: Command A at roughly $1.00 per million input tokens, Command R at $0.15/$0.60 per million input/output, Aya Expanse at $0.50/$1.50, Embed at $0.10 per million tokens and Rerank at $2.00 per 1,000 searches. North, its agentic platform, and Maestro-style orchestration sit on top.

The real margin engine is private deployment: Cohere runs its models inside customers' own cloud VPCs or entirely on-premise — including sovereign installs for national governments — where contracts are large, sticky and carry 70–80% gross margins. That willingness to stay out of the consumer race is why Cohere's valuation-to-ARR ratio is among the most conservative on this leaderboard.
revenueMix: On-prem and VPC contracts with 70–80% gross margins; the margin engine.
Command, Embed and Rerank priced from $0.10–$1.00 per million tokens.
National-government installs running Cohere models in-country.

faqs.a: Third-party estimates put Cohere's annualized run rate near $500 million in 2026, up from ~$240M at the end of 2025 (when it beat its own $200M target) and just ~$13M in 2023. Cohere itself has not published an official ARR figure.

Enterprise and government contracts: private deployments of its models inside customer VPCs or fully on-premise, plus a usage-based API (Command A at ~$1.00 per million input tokens, Embed at $0.10, Rerank at $2.00 per 1,000 searches).

faqs.q: Why Doesn't Cohere Have a Chatbot?
faqs.a: Deliberate strategy. Cohere skipped the consumer race to focus on secure, private enterprise and sovereign AI, which it argues wins larger, stickier contracts with better margins — and avoids competing head-on with OpenAI and Google.

faqs.q: What Is Cohere's Valuation and How Much Has It Raised?
faqs.a: $6.5–6.8 billion as of its August 2025 round ($500M led by Radical Ventures, with NVIDIA and Salesforce Ventures), after a $500M Series D at $5.5B in July 2024 and a $2.2B valuation in 2023. Total raised exceeds $1 billion.
A 2026 IPO has been reported as under discussion, which would make it one of the first pure-play enterprise LLM companies to list. The company has not officially confirmed timing.
